title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.8.0
subtitle: Faster repeat bakes with reliable PC2 playback.

highlights.title: Reuse unchanged animated Collider captures
highlights.description: Unchanged animated Collider captures are reused across repeat bakes.

highlights.title: Reuse validated Bake-start geometry
highlights.description: Bake-start simulation geometry is validated once and reused for export instead of reading the same evaluated vertices again.

highlights.title: Enable PC2 playback after successful Bakes
highlights.description: The Cloth NeXt Mesh Cache modifier now uses PC2 explicitly and becomes visible automatically after a successful bake.

highlights.title: Reuse topology validation's start-frame sample
highlights.description: Animated topology validation reuses the validated Bake-start sample instead of evaluating that frame twice.

highlights.title: Cache deterministic Collider modifier stacks
highlights.description: Self-contained Collider modifier stacks join the cache identity while external dependencies still invalidate safely.
